title: Research: three-repeat partitioned 8q priced obstruction (no new kappa)
body:
## Change and scope

Freestanding `#840`-style priced obstruction under [#1898](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1898) at `(b,a,x)=(38,2,2)`. Names a **fifth** dirt-legal readout alphabet at `Q=8` beyond same-walk / dirty-shadow / partitioned dual / one-repeat / two-repeat / shared-dirt: **three-repeat** (excess-3) layers on partitioned independent duals.

| Dual schedule | Valid | Covering pairs | Undercuts 436? |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| Three-repeat `(2,6)` | 930 | **0** | **no** |
| Three-repeat `(3,5)` | 0 | **0** | **no** |
| Three-repeat `(4,4)` | 0 | **0** | **no** |

Exact covering census is empty on every shape (span/coset bounds; `{d:4}` never restores; excess 3 impossible on L4), so there is no covering `R` and no undercut of the six-query endpoint.

**Scoped obstruction / priced alphabet; no new kappa.** Leave-alone through [#2867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2867) / [#2861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2861) / [#2860](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2860) / [#2858](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2858) / [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851) was not reopened.

## Result

Package: `research/independent-walks-threerepeat-8q/`.
Tip: `0aa5cf439fdf210a455b78b46b16b3c92ca38f87`.

Exact: covering **0** on `(2,6)`/`(3,5)`/`(4,4)`; no undercut of 436.

## Validation

```sh
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-threerepeat-8q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -O -B research/independent-walks-threerepeat-8q/verify.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-threerepeat-8q/independent.py
python3.12 -I -B research/independent-walks-threerepeat-8q/test_package.py
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/independent-walks-threerepeat-8q
```

Expected:

```text
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_THREEREPEAT_8Q_OBSTRUCTION covering_26=0 covering_35=0 covering_44=0 ... no_undercut_436 no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_THREEREPEAT_8Q covering_26=0 covering_35=0 ... no_undercut_436 no_new_kappa
PASS_INDEPENDENT_WALKS_THREEREPEAT_8Q_PACKAGE_TESTS groups=6
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/independent-walks-threerepeat-8q outcome=completed
```

Default verify is read-only. Admission uses `need()`; `-O` also passes.

## Overlap and credit

Closest prior: [#2867](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2867) (shared-dirt), [#2860](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2860) (two-repeat), [#2861](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2861), [#2851](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2851). Freestanding three-repeat alphabet; no competing open PR at refresh.
